description: Burial and RNA-path distance for every candidate RNA-contacting side chain of the LEE1 tandem zinc finger
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
Hd={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
NUC={'A','U','G','C'}
def parse(txt):
    lines=txt.split("\n"); has=any(l.startswith("MODEL ") for l in lines)
    rows=[];st=not has
    for ln in lines:
        if ln.startswith("MODEL "):
            if st: break
            st=True; continue
        if ln.startswith("ENDMDL") and has: break
        if st and ln.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            rs=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rs=="HOH": continue
            el=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0])
            if el in ("H","D"): continue
            if ln[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            rows.append((ln[21],int(ln[22:26]),rs,ln[12:16].strip(),el,float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["ch","num","res","atom","el","x","y","z"])
af=parse(open("AF_Q02799.pdb").read())
rg=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb",headers=Hd,timeout=180).text)
rgP=rg[rg.res.isin(AA3)]; rgR=rg[rg.res.isin(NUC)]
print("AF atoms",len(af),"| 1RGO protein",len(rgP),"RNA",len(rgR))
def anchors(c1,sp):
    a,b,c=sp
    return dict(zip(['C1']+[f'C1+{k}' for k in range(1,a+1)]+['C2']+[f'C2+{k}' for k in range(1,b+1)]
                    +['C3']+[f'C3+{k}' for k in range(1,c+1)]+['H'], range(c1,c1+4+a+b+c)))
Tz={'ZF1':anchors(159,(8,5,3)),'ZF2':anchors(197,(8,5,3))}
Lz={'ZF1':anchors(93,(7,5,3)), 'ZF2':anchors(124,(7,5,3))}
COMMON=['C1','C1+1','C1+2','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C2+3','C2+4','C2+5','C3','C3+1','C3+2','C3+3','H']
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); M=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(M)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R,Qc-R@Pc
def ca(df,n):
    r=df[(df.num==n)&(df.atom=="CA")]; return r[["x","y","z"]].values[0]
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'ZN':1.39}
def sasa(coords,els,n_pts=200,probe=1.4):
    i=np.arange(n_pts)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n_pts); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    sph=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
    r=np.array([VDW.get(e.upper(),1.7) for e in els])+probe
    D=np.linalg.norm(coords[:,None,:]-coords[None,:,:],axis=-1); out=np.zeros(len(coords))
    for k in range(len(coords)):
        nb=np.where((D[k]<r[k]+r.max())&(np.arange(len(coords))!=k))[0]
        pts=coords[k]+r[k]*sph; acc=np.ones(n_pts,bool)
        for j in nb: acc &= (np.linalg.norm(pts-coords[j],axis=1)>=r[j])
        out[k]=4*np.pi*r[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
MAXACC={'A':106,'R':248,'N':157,'D':163,'C':135,'Q':198,'E':194,'G':84,'H':184,'I':169,'L':164,'K':205,
        'M':188,'F':197,'P':136,'S':130,'T':142,'W':227,'Y':222,'V':142}
reg=af[(af.num>=85)&(af.num<=150)].reset_index(drop=True); reg["sasa"]=sasa(reg[["x","y","z"]].values,reg.el.values)
rs=reg.groupby("num").agg(res=("res","first"),tot=("sasa","sum"))
rs["aa"]=[AA3[r] for r in rs.res]; rs["rsa"]=rs.tot/[MAXACC[a] for a in rs.aa]
rs["sc"]=reg[~reg.atom.isin(["N","CA","C","O"])].groupby("num")["sasa"].sum()
# same for TIS11d protein alone (control)
tr=rgP[(rgP.num>=155)&(rgP.num<=220)].reset_index(drop=True); tr["sasa"]=sasa(tr[["x","y","z"]].values,tr.el.values)
trs=tr[~tr.atom.isin(["N","CA","C","O"])].groupby("num")["sasa"].sum()

rows=[]
for zf in ["ZF1","ZF2"]:
    P=np.array([ca(af,Lz[zf][l]) for l in COMMON]); Qq=np.array([ca(rgP,Tz[zf][l]) for l in COMMON])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Qq); rms=float(np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Qq)**2).sum(1).mean()))
    L=af[(af.num>=85)&(af.num<=150)].copy(); L[["x","y","z"]]=(R@L[["x","y","z"]].values.T).T+t
    rna=rgR[["x","y","z"]].values
    for lab in ['C1+1','C1+2','C1+3','C2+1','C2+2','C2+5','C3+1','C3+2']:
        n=Lz[zf][lab]
        a=L[(L.num==n)&(~L.atom.isin(["N","CA","C","O"]))]
        if len(a)==0: a=L[L.num==n]
        d=np.linalg.norm(a[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-rna[None,:,:],axis=-1).min()
        tn=Tz[zf][lab]; ta=rgP[(rgP.num==tn)&(~rgP.atom.isin(["N","CA","C","O"]))]
        if len(ta)==0: ta=rgP[rgP.num==tn]
        td=np.linalg.norm(ta[["x","y","z"]].values[:,None,:]-rna[None,:,:],axis=-1).min()
        rows.append(dict(finger=zf,anchor=lab,LEE1=f"{AA3[a.res.iloc[0]]}{n}",d_RNA=round(float(d),2),
                         sc_SASA=round(float(rs.loc[n,'sc']),1),RSA=round(float(rs.loc[n,'rsa']),2),
                         TIS11d=f"{AA3[ta.res.iloc[0]]}{tn}",TIS11d_d_RNA=round(float(td),2),
                         TIS11d_sc_SASA=round(float(trs.get(tn,np.nan)),1),rmsd14=round(rms,2)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== LEE1 TZF anchors: burial (isolated model) and distance to TIS11d-bound RNA after superposition ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv("lee1_anchor_sasa_and_rna_distance.csv",index=False)
print("\nRMSD over 14 common anchors: ZF1 %.2f A, ZF2 %.2f A"%(T[T.finger=='ZF1'].rmsd14.iloc[0],T[T.finger=='ZF2'].rmsd14.iloc[0]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(T)); w=0.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,T.d_RNA,w,label="LEE1 (superposed)",color="#3b7dd8")
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,T.TIS11d_d_RNA,w,label="TIS11d (RNA bound)",color="#d9843b")
ax[0].axhline(4.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[0].text(-0.4,4.2,"4 A contact cut-off",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels([f"{r.finger} {r.anchor}\n{r.LEE1}" for r in T.itertuples()],fontsize=7,rotation=45,ha='right')
ax[0].set_ylabel("side-chain min distance to RNA (A)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("LEE1 side chains placed on the TIS11d RNA path",fontsize=10)
cols=["#c0392b" if r.LEE1[0] in "FYW" else "#2980b9" if r.LEE1[0] in "KRH" else "#95a5a6" for r in T.itertuples()]
ax[1].bar(x,T.sc_SASA,color=cols)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{r.finger} {r.anchor}\n{r.LEE1}" for r in T.itertuples()],fontsize=7,rotation=45,ha='right')
ax[1].set_ylabel("side-chain SASA, isolated LEE1 TZF (A$^2$)")
ax[1].set_title("Red aromatic, blue basic: exposed side chains are\navailable for RNA, buried ones pack the core",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
